profile.name: Ciaccona
profile.review:
Ciaccona is a 5-star Aero Pistol DPS whose primary point of interest is her ability to apply Aero Erosion (mostly via her Ultimate). She can also apply Spectro Frazzle through it, though that’s quite underutilized nowadays. She also amplifies Aero Erosion DMG and boosts Aero DMG in several ways, and is characterized by her ability to rotate quickly while dealing good damage and providing good party-wide buffs.

Key Mechanics

Ciaccona’s rotations revolve around building up to her Forte and finishing her rotation off with her Ultimate. This is because her Forte has 3 charges, building it up fully allows her to cast a Forte Heavy Attack that restores significant amounts of Concerto quickly. On the other hand, Ciaccona’s Ultimate glues her in place and significantly limits her on-field actions. If swapped out and swapped back in, the Ultimate gets cancelled. In other words: build up towards her Forte Heavy, finish her rotation off with her Ultimate.

Ciaccona applies 1 stack of Aero Erosion through the following Skills:

  • Intro

  • Basic 4

  • Skill

  • Forte Heavy

  • Ultimate (1 stack every 1.6s) → Can also be switched to Spectro Frazzle after about 0.5s of extra field time if needed (nowadays not really utilized in any of Ciaccona’s best use cases).

Ciaccona’s Forte is restored through casting her Basic 4 or Intro (1/3 stacks per). Basic 4 can additionally be finished by something called an “Ensemble Sylph” if interrupted early. They act as “ghosts” of Ciaccona’s silhouette that finish Basic 4’s and upkeep buffs in her stead. Indeed, these same Ensemble Sylphs provide 24% Aero DMG Bonus for the whole team when generated, for an indefinite amount of time.

Finally, Ciaccona’s Outro amplifies the Aero Erosion DMG of the whole team by 100% for 30s, which doesn’t expire upon switching between characters. If her Signature weapon is owned, it also shreds enemy Aero RES by 10% upon applying and hitting an enemy with Aero Erosion (this can easily be upkept permanently in a fight).

Rotation Concepts

Ciaccona has a lot of combos and cancels that are all used in her rotations to make the most of the speed her kit provides her. Notably, we make use of the following properties:

  • Ciaccona’s Basic 4 can be freely interrupted on cast and fully finished by her Ensemble Sylphs;

  • Ciaccona’s Intro leads her to start her Basic chain from Basic 3;

  • Ciaconna’s Mid-air Attack 1 and 2 (her plunge) combo immediately into her Basic 4;

  • Ciaccona’s Forte Heavy Attack can be animation cancelled by her Ultimate as soon as the projectile is shot from her gun. The rest of the damage will occur during the Ultimate animation;

  • If switched into combat from mid-air, Ciaccona will immediately plunge downwards (Mid-air Attack 2). This combos into her Basic 4 almost instantly if close to the ground.

Outside of this, her Skill gives her a big burst of instant Concerto, and so does her Forte Heavy Attack, so we want to cast them after an Intro and fully charging up her Forte Heavy. Alongside her Ultimate, this generates enough Concerto to Outro extremely fast, leading Ciaccona to be one of the fastest Hybrid characters in the game.

Meta Position & Conclusion

In the meta, Ciaccona has a meta niche completely carved out for her. Her value essentially dies alongside that of Aero Erosion, since that’s her best use case as the only source of Aero Erosion application other than Cartethyia (a main damage dealer). The issue is, Cartethyia is the only DPS that revolves around this mechanic. While her and Ciaccona were intended to play together from the get-go, the team dates from version 2.4 (2.8 if you include Chisa, but she was barely an upgrade to the on-release team). In other words: the team is quite outdated by today’s standards.

One of the Aero Erosion team’s huge strengths is its affinity for Quickswap. Ciaccona can cast more than one Forte Heavy per rotation if the rest of the team’s Swap Cancel windows are fully properly utilized, sometimes 2, 3 or even 4 Forte Heavies can be cast per full team loop depending on how experienced the player is. If the Aero Erosion team is fully mastered, to this day, it’s a highly meta-relevant team. However, for more than 99% of the playerbase, that team is quite outdated and will face issues in endgame content when played at a baseline level.

Hence, Ciaccona can still find uses for more casual players as 3rd slot in Aero DPS teams. We see this in teams like Qingxiao/Lynae/Ciaccona, Iuno/Lynae/Ciaccona or Sigrika/Qiuyuan/Ciaccona. This is because she retains high personal damage and party-wide buffs, through her Echo Set Gusts of Welkin, giving 15% Aero DMG Bonus to the team, her permanent 24% Aero DMG Bonus through her Ensemble Sylphs, and most importantly of all, her Signature weapon. Indeed, 10% Aero RES shred is a very rare buff that Ciaccona is lucky to provide, especially considering all of her buffs are very easy to upkeep permanently when properly played. However, it’s dependent on that bit of extra investment to actually own her Signature weapon, before she can utilize the full extent of her party-wide buffing strength. On the other hand, her Spectro Frazzle mode sees no use in endgame content nowadays, and was mostly a thing to give her some teams to play on her release before Cartethyia released. It’s long since powercrept and sees no use in the top Spectro Frazzle teams though, where Phoebe and Spectro Rover are heavily favoured over her.

In conclusion, Ciaccona is still a meta-relevant character for the Aero Erosion team with Cartethyia. Outside of this, she can still find use as a 3rd slot Support to Aero DPS teams, but this is heavily dependent on owning her Signature weapon in order to be worth considering. The Cartethyia team has also fallen out of fashion for the majority of players in the game. So while Ciaccona still has her strengths, she is generally not a recommended pull for new players, and casual players in general. Consider carefully before choosing to pull her: make sure she’s surrounded by the correct teammates, has her Signature if used in the 3rd slot, and is played properly in the Aero Erosion team to keep up with the meta.
profile.pros:
• Good general Aero buffs party-wide and low rotation time for good personal damage can make her a valid 3rd slot option for Aero damage dealers;

  • Access to Aero Erosion allows for explicit synergy with Cartethyia;

  • Very quickswap-friendly, optimization ceiling is big in a variety of teams.
profile.cons:
• Her value effectively dies as a Best In Slot alongside Aero Erosion, which hasn’t received any new damage dealer since Cartethyia. The team still deals high damage in Quickswap, but the baseline performance for that team has fallen out of fashion a long time ago;

  • Can apply Spectro Frazzle, but that’s effectively useless because it hasn’t received updates for a very long time and is long since powercrept;

  • Signature weapon is a strong party-wide utility and you can lose out on a lot of her value if you skip it;

  • Very low Sequence value across the board, vertical investment isn’t really an option on her beyond getting her Signature weapon.
profile.rotations:
Rotation & How to Play

In most cases, Ciaccona’s rotation goal is to build towards her Forte Heavy Attack as quickly as possible by gaining 3 Forte stacks: 1 through her Intro and 2 through 2 Basic 4’s. To do this, she has a lot of animation cancels we strongly recommend executing, even at a baseline level, to make her a very fast secondary character.

Echo Timing

Skip using Nightmare: Kelpie’s active Echo cast and only rely on the Summon executed upon Outro. If on Reminiscence: Fleurdelys, cast it at any point in her rotation (try to activate her self-buffs and other team buffs before using it on the first rotation though). 

If you want to use Ciaccona on Frazzle mode, make sure to switch to it after her Ultimate before her Outro. This adds about 0.5s of rotation time.

Standard Rotation

Used in most cases in most teams if an Intro is available.

  • Intro

  • Basic 3

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation on cast via Skill)

  • Skill

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Cancel animation when shot via Ultimate)

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

At S6, we still end up using the above rotation because the S3-S5 rotation barely saves any time and the extra multiplier on Basic 4’s at S6 is too advantageous to pass up.

Standard Opener Rotation

If using Ciaccona as a 3rd slot, she can start the team’s rotation without an Intro like so:

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Cancel animation on cast via Skill)

  • Skill

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Cancel animation when shot by Ultimate)

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

At S3 and higher, you can remove 1 Jump, Mid-Air Attack, Basic 4 string from the above rotation to speed it up significantly.

S3-S5 Rotation

The rotation below is faster than the standard one at S3-S5 by making use of the extra Skill charge and Forte generation provided by the S3. Not utilized at S6 because of much lower damage than the standard rotation.

  • Intro

  • Basic 3

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Skill)

  • Skill (2 times)

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when shot via Ultimate)

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

S0-S2 DPS Rotation

If you want to play Ciaccona as a Main DPS with Sanhua, she can use the rotation below to cast multiple Forte Heavies per on-field rotation and deal more damage (generally not recommended and off-meta, but we included it to be complete):

  • Intro

  • Basic 3

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Skill)

  • Skill

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when shot via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when close enough to the ground via Ultimate)

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

To optimize the Opener rotation, at the very start of the fight, Ciaccona can cast Jump, Mid-air 1-2, Basic 4 and Ultimate (Swap), to immediately give the party 24% Aero DMG Bonus (including herself) and start ramping up some Ultimate/Aero Erosion damage.

S3+ DPS Rotation

Same concept as the above rotation, but utilizes extra Forte generation from S3 to cast 3 Forte Heavies. Makes the most sense to use at S6, where Ciaccona gains sufficient Basic 4 damage multipliers to compete with other main damage dealers, but can be used beforehand too.

  • Intro

  • Basic 3

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Dash)

  • Dash

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when shot via Jump)

  • Jump 

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Skill)

  • Skill

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when shot via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Jump)

  • Jump

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 1

  • Basic: Mid-air Attack 2

  • Basic 4 (Animation cancel on cast via Skill)

  • Skill

  • Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat (Animation cancel when shot via Ultimate)

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

To optimize the Opener rotation, at the very start of the fight, Ciaccona can cast Jump, Mid-air 1-2, Basic 4 and Ultimate (Swap), to immediately give the party 24% Aero DMG Bonus (including herself) and start ramping up some Ultimate/Aero Erosion damage.

Additional Tips & Tricks

Ciaconna is a very Quickswap-friendly character, much like the rest of the Aero Erosion team members. In her specific case, the best Quickswap she has access to involves her swapping in combat in mid-air in order to immediately cast her Mid-air 2 (the plunging attack) and follow up with a Basic 4 in record times.

With that being said, her Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat is also a good Swap Cancel window (particularly good following a Jump Cancel Basic 4), and generally speaking she can weave in Jump → Mid-Air 1-2 → Basic 4 Combos to deal some good damage during other characters’ Quickswap windows. This can also allow her to cast more than one Heavy: Quadruple Downbeat per rotation, so long as she generates the necessary Forte stacks.

It’s also possible to switch out of a Jump Mid-air 1 and cast Mid-air 2 upon coming back, though this is an extremely tight window used by the most advanced players only.

Mix and match these Quickswap combos to create fast and high-damaging Quickswap team rotations!

skills.name: Quadruple Time Steps
skills.description:
Basic Attack

  • Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion upon the target hit.

  • When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, press Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.

  • After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a Solo Concert. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or Solo Concert ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an Ensemble Sylph is generated.

Solo Concert

When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

Ensemble Sylph

  • Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.

  • If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter Solo Concert.

  • If Ciaccona's Solo Concert is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will continue the Solo Concert for Ciaccona.

  • Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by Resonance Skill will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering Solo Concert.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Aimed Attack

Press Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing Aero DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Press Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter

Follow up successful Dodges with Basic Attack to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

skills.name: Harmonic Allegro
skills.description:
Move a certain distance, dealing Aero DMG and inflicting 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target upon hit.

Press Normal Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

  • When Ciaccona interrupts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Solo Concert with Resonance Skill, an Ensemble Sylph is generated.

  • Ciaccona's Resonance Skill can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Singer's Triple Cadenza
skills.description:
Ciaccona and Ensemble Sylphs perform an Improvised Symphonic Poem together, dealing Aero DMG once to the nearby targets and entering Recital.

Recital

When in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, press the green or yellow buttons to generate Symphonic Poem: Tonic of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.

During Recital

  • Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a Symphonic Poem: Tonic matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green Symphonic Poem: Tonic is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.

  • Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes 50% less DMG.

  • Exit Recital by pressing Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.

  • Ensemble Sylphs can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by Solo Concert.

Symphonic Poem: Tonic

  • Green Tonic: Deal Aero DMG to nearby targets and inflict a stack of Aero Erosion on targets hit.

  • Yellow Tonic: Deal Aero DMG to nearby targets and inflict a stack of Spectro Frazzle on targets hit.

skills.name: Symphony of Wind and Verse
skills.description:
Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat

When there are 3 segments of Musical Essence, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat.

Consume all Musical Essence to shoot Downbeat Notes forward to deal Aero DMG, pulling in the nearby targets and inflicting 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target hit.

Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Musical Essence

Ciaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.

Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Intro Skill recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.

skills.name: Interlude Tune
skills.description: Casting Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza grants Ciaccona a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. Switching out Ciaccona removes the Shield.

skills.name: Winds of Rinascita
skills.description: Increase Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat's DMG by 30%.

skills.name: Roaming with the Wind
skills.description:
Attack the target to deal Aero DMG and inflict a stack of Aero Erosion.

Follow up with Basic Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Windcalling Tune
skills.description: Aero Erosion DMG dealt to targets near the active Resonator is Amplified by 100% for 30s.

dupes.dupe2: During Resonance Liberation Singer's Triple Cadenza, Resonators in the team gain 40% Aero DMG Bonus.
dupes.dupe3: Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 additionally grants 1 segments of Musical Essence. Resonance Skill Harmonic Allegro gains 1 more charge.

Ciaccona ignores 45% of the targets' DEF when dealing Resonance Liberation DMG.

weapons.Comment: The best option overall for Ciaccona not only from a personal damage perspective but also from a team damage perspective as this weapon shreds the Aero RES of enemies by 10%, which is particularly useful in Aero teams. Still outclasses all other options in any teams thanks to its big personal damage boost.

An amazing generalist permanently available pistol that can universally improve the wearer's ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG. Can get close to a lot of character signatures and is overall a must-have for most accounts. Better than Static Mist in compositions that don't benefit from its ATK buff such as Cartethyia's team.

Lynae's Signature weapon can proivde extra Basic Attack DMG to Ciaccona and also has a lot of CRIT Rate and ATK for her to benefit from, however she cannot trigger the party-wide buff this weapon provides which makes it generally worse than the permanent banner weapons.

Best Echo with this weapon is Reminiscence: Fleurdelys. Galbrena's Signature has a good Base ATK and CRIT DMG boosts, but can also amplify Heavy Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG when both damage types are triggered close to one another alongside an extra DEF Ignore buff. Ciaccona takes a solid damage increase from the Heavy Attack DMG Amplify and DEF Ignore towards the end of her rotation if she uses her Echo Skill while her Forte Heavy Attack is about to cast, making it a great alternative overall.

While Ciaccona takes full advantage of this weapon's passive thanks to her really short rotation, Skill DMG is the most negligible part of her damage types which makes this weapon mostly an atk and CRIT DMG stat-stick. Still a good choice for personal damage overall.

Can outclass Phasic Homogenizer in ATK-scaling teams thanks to team buffing. One of the 2 best permanently available options for Ciaccona, which makes her give 10% ATK to the next character she Outros into and also provides her with high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and some Energy Regen, making her take full advantage of the weapon's passive.

Best 4-star and F2P no-gacha option for Ciaccona, this Rinascita craftable synergizes well with her ability to apply Aero Erosion constantly on enemies, allowing her to take full advantage of this weapon's massive ATK increase. Still lower than other options because it only provides ATK (and 4-stars have lower Base ATK than 5-stars too which makes increasing ATK% less effective).

echoes.Comment: Best set for Aero Erosion supports. Allows characters that can apply Aero Erosion to gain a total of 40% Aero DMG Bonus, an equivalent to Sierra Gale. However, it gains an edge over this set by being able to give 15% of that Aero DMG Bonus to the whole team for 20s, providing both offensive and supportive benefits. This set is only favoured on Ciaccona if an Aero Main DPS is present in the team. Use Moonlit Clouds if this doesn't apply.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats, or use Fleurdelys if Ciaccona uses Lux & Umbra as her weapon as explained above!)

echoes.Comment: Best set for Ciaccona in all non-Aero teams. This set sacrifices Ciaccona's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill, making it one of the strongest sets to buff any ATK-scaling DPS.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. On Ciaccona, this Echo should either be used before her rotation starts or it can be instantly interrupted at any point via a Dash - this way, no Energy or damage is generated but the buff will still apply to the incoming character.

echoes.Comment: Used with Main DPS Ciaccona. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

skillPriority.Order: Res. Liberation, Basic Attack, Forte Circuit, Intro Skill, Res. Skill
skillPriority.Comments: Skill and Intro can be skipped when levelling to save on resources at a minimal damage loss.

teams.Name: Team #2: Cartethyia Team
teams.Comments: Chisa is only stronger than Aero Rover with her Signature. Shorekeeper is also mostly usable in the third slot in Whimpering Wastes since Aero Erosion won't have time to ramp up to 6.

teams.Name: Team #4: Other Aero Teams
teams.Comments: Iuno + Lynae + Ciaccona is also one of DPS Iuno's strongest teams by far, exceeding the teams shown here if you have access to it.

teams.Name: Team #5: Spectro Frazzle Teams
teams.Comments: Shorekeeper will only really see use on DPS Phoebe teams in Whimpering Wastes, however it is DPS Phoebe's best Whimpering Wastes team and is worth mentioning.

synergies.Comment: Ciaccona is at her best in Aero Erosion or Aero damage-focused teams, whether in the second or the third slot. This is because she provides universal Aero DMG buffs, and a coveted Aero RES Shred with her Signature weapon alongside solid personal damage and a quick rotation which makes her good in all Aero-based teams; she also has off-field Aero Erosion application which makes her the best partner for Cartethyia by far. Overall she is a very flexible character for all Aero teams in the game.

Ciaccona is also appreciated in Spectro Frazzle-based teams since she can switch from applying Aero Erosion off-field to Spectro Frazzle. This makes her the only possible partner for Absolution Phoebe to function in Whimpering Wastes, and she is also a fine alrernative to Zani teams if Phoebe isn't available, since she can allow for Zani to extend her rotation to cast 3 powerful Nightfall attacks instead of 2 without Phoebe involved. However, outside of Absolution Phoebe in Whimpering Wastes, there's always a choice that outclasses her in Spectro Frazzle teams.

If you want to play Ciaccona as a Main DPS, Sanhua is your best option, enabling this playstyle by providing a massive 38% Basic ATK DMG Amplification, good ATK% and DMG% buffs via S6 and Echo sets as well as having a lightning fast rotation to allow Ciaccona to have the highest field time possible. Easily the best option to use Ciaccona as an on-field DPS.

Ciaccona's long list of Support choices is a byproduct of her huge team flexibility. Chisa and Aero Rover both see use in teams with Cartethyia to enable Aero Erosion to ramp up to 6; Aero Rover is also used alongside Main DPS Iuno for general Aero buffs; Spectro Rover is used with Zani and Phoebe for higher Spectro Frazzle application; lastly, Shorekeeper and Verina are your best generalist bets. Pick and choose based on your team and what's available, Ciaccona works well with all of them!

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12.00% Glacio DMG Bonus and 12.00% Aero DMG Bonus. Switching out the Resonator with Outro Skill summons Nightmares: Kelpie to deal 405.00% Aero DMG.\n\nCD: 25s.

echoes.Name: Reminiscence: Fleurdelys
echoes.Echo_skill: Summon the Windcleaver to attack the target, dealing {0} Aero DMG 8 times and {1} Aero DMG once. The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains 10.00% Aero DMG Bonus. If this Resonator is Rover: Aero or Cartethyia, grant another 10.00% Aero DMG Bonus.\n\nCD: 20s.

echoes.Name: Reminiscence: Threnodian - Leviathan
echoes.Echo_skill: Summon a Collapsing Horizon, dealing two instances of {0} Havoc DMG to the nearby enemies and obtaining the Core of Collapse for 15s. While it lasts, Core of Collapse deals 24.57% Havoc DMG when the active Resonator in the team deals damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, up to 8. Enemies with Havoc Bane take 100% more DMG from this effect. The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12% Havoc DMG Bonus and 12% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.\n\nCD: 25s.

echoSets.name: Moonlit Clouds

echoSets.name: Thread of Severed Fate
echoSets.bonus_3: Inflicting Havoc Bane increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% and grants 30% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s.

echoSets.name: Windward Pilgrimage
